sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid Applicant apprehending his
arrest in C.R.No.110 of 2020 registered with Jodhbhavi Peth Police Station, Solapur, for offences
under Section 294-A, 420 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 7, 8, 9 of the
Maharashtra Lottery Registration Act and under Section 66D of the Information & Technology Act.
2.
By order dated 5th August, 2020, this Court (Coram Sarang V. Kotwal, J.) had for the reasons stated in the application, granted interim bail to the Applicants.
3. Learned APP states that the Applicants have co-operated with the investigation and that the investigation is almost completed.
Learned pps 1 of 2 17 aba 857-21.doc APP states that chargesheet has been filed against five co-accused and that the custodial interrogation of these Applicants is not warranted.

In view of the said statement, and considering the reasons stated in the order dated 5th August, 2020, the Applicants are ordered to be released on bail on the following terms and conditions:-

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in Crime No.110 of 2020 registered with Jodhbhavi Peth Police Station, Solapur, the Applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twentyfive Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigation Officer.

(ii) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for two days on 27th and 28th March, 2023 between 11.00 a.m. to 2.00 p.m. and further as and when required by the Investigating Officer for the purpose of investigation and interrogation.
(iii) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile/contact details, and/or change of residence or mobile/contact details from time to time.

(iv) The Applicant shall not interfere with the Complainant and the other witnesses,
or tamper with the evidence in any manner.

(ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
